paragraphs: Hyman describes him as Rav Yosef’s student and Abaye’s colleague, citing [Shabbat 60a](https://www.sefaria.org/Shabbat.60a.6).[^1][^2]

notes.text: The linked passage places him before Rav Yosef, explaining a ruling about a hairpin.

[Heilprin’s notice](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=219&lang=en) cites this occurrence and also records Abaye addressing him. Hyman describes him as Rav Yosef’s student and Abaye’s colleague.
